headline: The federal government cut the petrol price by Re1 to Rs313 per litre and high-speed diesel by Rs2 to Rs346 per litre for November 27, according to an OGRA press release reported by The Express Tribune.

card.desc: Petrol Rs313 aur diesel Rs346 per litre ho gaya

caption:
Petrol aur diesel phir saste ho gaye! ⛽
Express Tribune ke mutabiq hukumat ne 27 November ke liye petrol ki qeemat mein Re1 aur high-speed diesel ki qeemat mein Rs2 per litre ki kami kar di hai. OGRA ki press release ke mutabiq ab petrol Rs313 aur diesel Rs346 per litre mein milega. Is se ek din pehle petrol Rs4 aur diesel Rs5 sasta hua tha.
Kya aap ko qeematon mein yeh kami mehsoos ho rahi hai? Comment mein batayein 👇
